headline: Approved accepting state funds for Putnam Terrace brownfield cleanup at 344-350 Putnam Avenue, plus the Mill River Trail design project.
summary: Two other items were approved: an amendment to an engineering and environmental consulting services agreement, and a master municipal agreement for state rights of way projects. All votes passed unanimously.
decisions: Approved amendment #2 to the engineering and environmental consulting services agreement, unanimously, 0 opposed.
Approved master municipal agreement for Connecticut Department of Transportation rights of way projects, unanimously, 0 opposed.
Approved project authorization letter with the state for the Mill River Trail design project, unanimously, 0 opposed.
Approved accepting and spending state funds for brownfield remediation at Putnam Terrace, 344-350 Putnam Avenue, unanimously, 0 opposed.
